db_full_name: Cella LAB — Synthetic Microbial Consortium Database
tagline: A curated knowledge base supporting the rational design of synthetic microbial consortia.
intro: Cella LAB integrates published and industrially documented synthetic consortia, metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), pangenome analyses, and metabolic pathways into a single, queryable resource. It provides evidence-based theoretical support for the bottom-up design of microbial communities with defined functions.

modules.title: Synthetic Consortia
modules.desc: Functionally defined communities collected from literature and commercial products, with strain composition, cross-feeding networks and functional descriptions.

modules.title: Metagenome Samples
modules.desc: Microbial community profiling from feces, wastewater, soil, lake water and other environments, with MAGs, gene annotations and sample metadata.

modules.title: Pangenome Analysis
modules.desc: Pangenome comparison across consortia and environments: core/soft-core/shell/cloud gene families, PAV matrices, SV and synteny analysis.

modules.title: Metabolic Pathways
modules.desc: Pathway maps explaining the functional origin and molecular mechanisms of consortium phenotypes, with genes, metabolites and reactions.
